test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
By folding the given paper, which of the following box cannot be made? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2efd2e508ffd5836e2cc6f2df8d352fdf643a2bebafe49f698188047a515cbb4.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92393c8b127283aa199af9c074a16d66225027df7914164fad586c18fb86f7c8.png] 

M and A is the opposite sides.

K and 7 is the opposite sides.

J and L is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2241bfb4338f06224fbb6632ae6b297ba63b37a12b0d67225a1ad7f4e0b6274.png] → Can be made, because no opposite sides in the given Dice.

**Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cff2d0104d12cfdfbd8bcad45eba40c3148536008d6fce266c01e809a9be643b.png] → **Can not be made, because J and L are the opposite sides.**

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0ab7282eba3383b743c55de4e2415aa759eff8913ae5c1d636f73d058134e6.png] → Can be made, because no opposite sides in the given Dice.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ab89acceb1af083e34a9099d5fad0962bb3a44923a745674c2ea1a63ed32cf7.png] → Can be made, because no opposite sides in the given Dice.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
